_hedge_note: Rule H, split hedge (Dongmin 2026-11-06): a temporary hedge when a group you are heavy in crashes. Each stock is hedged against the index it follows most closely (highest R^2): chip-like names against SOXX with SOXS (-3x), the rest against QQQ with PSQ (-1x). A leg opens when its index is down >= z x its usual daily move or >= dd20_pct below its 20-day high, and below its lower band, while the group is >= min_weight_pct of the book. Size: ratio x the leg's beta-weighted exposure / leverage. Exit per leg: Rule A BUY on its index, back above the middle of its range, +rebound_pct, or its max_sessions. Telegram only.
_holdings_repo_note: Private repo whose holdings.json (v2 shape) the post-close run keeps up to date. Read with the HOLDINGS_TOKEN secret (read-only). The newer of it and HOLDINGS_JSON, by as_of, is used.
